name: goodstuff
description: Agent plugins from Good Stuff Software — practical tools built from real multi-machine use.

plugins.name: discord
plugins.description: Operate your own Discord server from Claude — guided bot setup, building out a category/channel structure, and posting release notes safely. Packages the Apache-2.0 cappyeo/discord-mcp server rather than reimplementing it.

plugins.name: session-sync
plugins.description: Roam Claude Code conversations between machines. Syncs the transcripts AND the desktop app's session index, so chats come back in the sidebar instead of only via `claude --resume`.
